description: PRD slices derived from breadboards 2.1–2.6 for a deterministic Quick Start pipeline.

userStories.title: Question set JSON + versioning

acceptanceCriteria: Question set v1 has <=25 questions with stable IDs
Version tag is included in run metadata
Running pack_01_clean produces one row per question_id

userStories.title: Row schema + migrations
userStories.description: As an operator, row schema is stable and migrations preserve data.
acceptanceCriteria: Row schema includes question_id, question, answer, citations[], status, confidence?, docs_searched[]

Migration leaves existing rows readable

userStories.title: UI table columns + row drawer layout

acceptanceCriteria: Row table renders fixed columns for pack_01_clean

userStories.title: Commitment doc-type classifier + parser routing

acceptanceCriteria: Commitment docs in pack_01_clean and pack_04_multi_parcel_complex route to parser
Unknown doc types are flagged as needs_review

userStories.title: B-I extraction logic (requirements)

userStories.title: B-II extraction logic (exceptions)

acceptanceCriteria: pack_01_clean yields exceptions list matching truth key fields

userStories.title: Ambiguity UI + user selection
